text: 工业和信息化部副部长辛国斌在2026世界机器人大会开幕式上表示，2025年机器人产业规模以上企业营业收入突破3000亿元，近五年年均增速超20%，今年上半年达到1655亿元，同比增长24.5%。机器人技术和产品已广泛应用于国民经济和社会发展的方方面面，成为推动高质量发展的重要力量。
text_en: At the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Robot Conference, Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology Xin Guobin stated that in 2025, revenue of enterprises above designated size in the robotics industry exceeded 300 billion yuan, with an average annual growth rate of over 20% in the past five years. In the first half of this year, revenue reached 165.5 billion yuan, up 24.5% year on year. Robotic technologies and products have been widely applied across all aspects of national economic and social development, becoming a significant force driving high-quality growth.
